stem_book: An object of mass M₁ moving horizontally with speed u collides elastically with another object of mass M₂ at rest. Select correct statement. [Figure: M₁ moving with u along the top; M₂ with centre C on line P–Q; line of impact S–R passes through both centres] (a) The momentum of system is conserved only in direction PQ (b) Momentum of M₁ is conserved in direction perpendicular to SR (c) Momentum of M₂ will change in direction normal to CR (d) All of these
correct_answer: b Momentum of M₁ is conserved in direction perpendicular to SR
reason: Manifest key mis-copied: printed key is (b), which matches working; (a) false (system momentum conserved in every direction), (c) false (M₂'s momentum changes along CR, not normal to it)
work: impulse acts only along line of centres SR ⇒ M₁'s momentum ⊥ SR unchanged ⇒ (b)
